description: Check every third-party input of a deliverable (images, fonts, data, code: by resource_id, license or asset) for its intended use, reusing licenses you hold, and get a signed manifest plus a plain-text summary to ship with the work. Its hash is committed to the ledger; anyone can verify it with verify_rights_manifest. Call with {"title": "Spring campaign", "intended_use": {"commercial_use": true}, "items": [{"ref": "font", "license": "OFL-1.1"}, {"ref": "code", "license": "MIT"}]}.

api_key.description: Your Rightshold API key (rs_...). Only needed if your MCP client cannot send Authorization: Bearer <key>.

intended_use.description: Intended use. Every true flag is a right the assessment must find documented; omitted flags are false. Unknown fields are refused (invalid_intended_use). For instance {"commercial_use":true,"deployment":true,"attribution_planned":true,"duration_days":365}

duration_days.description: Whole days of use (1 to 36500), or null for no fixed term

geography.description: worldwide (default) or a region code such as US, EU, UK
